Original foggy Victorian industrial world: cobblestone, gas lamps, soot brick, wrought iron, canals, occult undertones. Strict pixel grid, crisp hard edges, no anti-aliasing, blur or gradients. Deliberate two-tone checker dithering on large surfaces only. 1px deep blue-grey #1a1c2c outline on people, props, icons; terrain without outline. Maximum 32 muted colors: slate blues, fog greys, soot browns, moss greens, rust/brass, bone white. Warm amber only lamps/candles; turquoise #6fe0d0 or deep violet only supernatural. Flat 2-3 shade steps, light top-left. Melancholic, mysterious, never gory. No text, letters, numbers, watermark or signature. Avoid 3D, painterly, photorealism, chibi, anime and franchise references.
Stone stairs descend to vast register archive cellar. FOUR animation frames identical camera: water retreats down steps, more stairs exposed in each.  IMPORTANT: output these FOUR frames in a TWO COLUMN TWO ROW grid. Each panel landscape 16:9. Overall image 16:9. Read order top-left, top-right, bottom-left, bottom-right. Same camera and background in all four. Edge to edge, no margins or panel lines.
